Costa Rica

8 directory entries · Research in progress

  • Bribri↗Language community connection
    Connection & source
    Language community connection

    Opening locates Bribri in the Talamanca and Buenos Aires regions of Costa Rica. No census/speaker figures adopted; cross-border communities are not excluded.

    Language-community geography in overview updated 2020. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Brörán↗Present community connection
    Connection & source
    Present community connection

    Article identifies Térraba/Brörán in southern Costa Rica. Country association only; no current land-status conclusion or equation with a Panamanian government.

    Community described in December 2017 reporting. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Cabécar↗documented community
    Connection & source
    documented community

    The Ministry's actual text explicitly includes Cabécar among the Indigenous peoples of Costa Rica and credits its Intercultural Education Department. Whole-country navigation association only, not exclusive residence, mapped territory or present government jurisdiction.

    Costa Rican Ministry of Education resource page dated 2024; not a current demographic survey. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗ · Supporting source 1 ↗
  • Chorotega↗historical and present
    Connection & source
    historical and present

    Text locates historical Chorotega in northern Costa Rica and identifies descendants at Matambú. Language loss is not treated as disappearance of people.

    Historical language area; descendant community described in source. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

  • Teribe↗documented community
    Connection & source
    documented community

    General-data table explicitly identifies Teribe/Térraba in Costa Rica, distinct from Naso naming in Panama. Retains the existing broad profile label; not a claim of one cross-border government.

    Public reference uses census-2000 context; uploaded by 2010, not a present legal-boundary record. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
